title: Generate a full-body, clean-background Midjourney character portrait (e.g…
content:
Generate a full-body, clean-background Midjourney character portrait (e.g., anime style, highly detailed, studio lighting, sharp focus) to use as the base reference for Seedance 2.0 character consistency.

In ChatGPT (GPT-2.0), upload your character image (image1) plus a key prop/vehicle image (image2) and prompt it to create a 2.5D identity board that preserves face, hair, eyes, outfit, and colors with 100% consistency across all panels.

Specify an identity board layout that includes a large centered header (character name + “CHARACTER IDENTITY BOARD”), an 8-pose “MOVEMENT & POSE” row (standing idle, sweet smile, walking, running, jumping, landing three-point, crouching, relax), and a right-column sidebar for eye close-up, hair swatch, clothing details grid, and shoe details grid.

Add a requirement for one zoom-in front-view focus panel on the left side to lock facial identity for Seedance 2.0.

Include style/output constraints in the prompt (high-end 2.5D concept, clean detail, soft studio lighting, 16:9, 4K) and explicitly state “No design drift” to enforce consistent character identity.
